hints.voice: If source/ is missing: cp -r {SKILL}/assets/template source && (cd source && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund). Then: python3 {S}/voice.py --project . --emit source/src/timing.js
hints.visuals: Write the film in source/src/film.js (kit: source/src/kit/, look: source/src/kit/style.js, guide: {SKILL}/references/threejs-guide.md). Stills (SwiftShader, about 3 s each): node {S}/film3d.mjs stills chapters --project . --q draft && node {S}/film3d.mjs stills lines --project . --q draft , plus a few with the final look: node {S}/film3d.mjs stills busy --project . --q final . Open every still with Read, fix, re-shoot. Check text size and contrast: python3 {S}/legibility.py --project . (fix every red box in stills/legibility/, re-shoot, re-run), then: python3 {S}/vstate.py attest visuals "<what you checked and fixed>"
hints.render: node {S}/film3d.mjs bench --project . --q final   (fps + ETA), then in the background: mkdir -p build && node {S}/film3d.mjs render --project . --q final --workers 2 --max-minutes 100 > build/render.log 2>&1 . Poll: tail -n 3 build/render.log. Exit 3 = budget reached: run the same command again (finished segments are kept) until the log says 'wrote'. Speeds here (2 workers, final): ~0.8 frames/s at 1080p, ~1.8 at 720p on a quiet box, 2-3x slower under load. Too slow? --q fast (75% render scale, text stays sharp, ~1.6x faster) or GPU=1 on a laptop. Then: python3 {S}/vstate.py advance
